notes: Restores the whole-UI scaling control upstream removed (tdf#101646, 38 CC / 8 duplicates) as a persisted percentage on Tools > Options > Appearance, mirroring the proven MaterialDensity control. This is a STORED-VALUE-ONLY control in this stage: the officecfg MaterialUiScale value is persisted and round-tripped through the cui page, but no metric consumes the scale factor yet, so it is honest-inert exactly like MaterialDensity. Apply is the EXISTING restart path (see the shared material-appearance-options contract); there is no live rescale. Source evidence only: runtime_verified is false and stored_only is true; the mutation suite proves that promoting either flag fails closed.

controller.note: The cui page must both READ the stored value (accessor ::get() feeding the spin's set_value in ResetMaterial) and WRITE it back (accessor ::set() from CommitMaterialAppearance). A read-only or write-only binding is a broken round-trip and must fail closed.
